title: The satisfying finishing detail
objective: Advertise the homepage's magnetic-cap feature through a clear physical demonstration, then connect it to the existing shopping offer.
casting: One adult Filipino woman, hands and forearms only, demonstrating the white-label Mojito Metallique bottle.
description: The magnetic cap clicks neatly into place. A satisfying finishing touch to your everyday fragrance.
scene: A close-up at a glossy red vanity with golden light. One hand steadies the bottle while the other lifts and replaces its black cap. A small cream hair claw and yellow cuff give the technical feature the same playful lifestyle mood as the scent ads.
styling: Coral manicure and golden-yellow cotton sleeve. Keep the camera below shoulder level. If a mirror edge appears, angle it only toward an empty wall.
props: Actual Mojito bottle and its matching cap, red lacquer surface, cream hair claw, white bounce card. Use a clean lens and wipe fingerprints between takes.
lighting: Raking sunlight or a warm hard key produces a crisp cap highlight. Add soft fill so the black hollow cap underside and silver atomizer remain distinct.
camera: Macro or close focus from just above label height. Keep cap, nozzle and bottle in one focus plane. Shoot the movement at normal speed first; also record a slower insert with the same framing.
performance: Hold the glass firmly with the left hand. Lift the cap straight up with the right, show the small air gap, then lower it gently until it seats. The cap stays physically held until closure; do not stage unsupported hovering.
sound: Record the real cap closure closely in a quiet room. Duck music during the click. Do not replace it with an exaggerated lock, suction or mechanical effect.
shots: Open on the bottle and hand-held cap with a small visible gap, then lower it once.

title: A shelf with personality
objective: Turn the homepage's collectible presentation into a concrete reason to explore more than one fragrance.
casting: One adult Filipino woman's hand arranging the two white-label women's products. No face or body above forearm level.
description: Build a scent collection that looks as good on your shelf as it feels in your routine.
scene: A cherry-red shelf against a warm ochre wall. Mojito Metallique and Amber Oud Silk stand in front of their exact yellow and peach canisters. A cream scalloped dish at the edge provides a lived-in apartment styling cue.
styling: Coral nails, one simple gold ring, peach or cream cuff. Keep the bottles and their canisters the dominant shapes.
props: Two exact bottles, two matching closed canisters, red shelf, cream dish. Do not add other perfume varieties, prices or bundle graphics.
lighting: Hard side sun with a soft fill at label height. Retain separate yellow and peach colors, with enough contrast between peach canister and warm wall.
camera: Shoot straight toward the shelf from slightly above bottle height. Keep both labels sharp; use a slow short slider move only after the locked master take.
performance: Move one bottle a few centimeters into its final position, withdraw the hand, then introduce the second. Each bottle should stay safely on the shelf; avoid clinking glass together.
sound: Licensed bright instrumental, a gentle canister set-down and subtle glass contact with a padded shelf surface. Keep voiceover clear.

title: London fragrance, Filipino spirit
objective: Introduce why Dear Body exists and its aspiration for Filipino everyday life using the approved brand story.
casting: One adult Filipino woman holding white-label Amber Oud Silk, and one adult Filipino man holding black-label Charme Envoûtant. Only hands, forearms and torso edges appear.
description: Mission: carefully curated fragrances from London that complement Filipino tastes, lifestyle and the tropical environment. Vision: bring London's fragrance culture into every Filipino's everyday life.
scene: Overhead close-up of a sunny yellow bench at a creative studio or cafe. Her red pouch sits at left; his burgundy bag strap rests at right. An orange notebook stays at the edge. Two different styles meet in one shared everyday moment.
styling: Her peach cotton sleeve and coral manicure; his cream tee and natural nails. No facial features, upper-chest crops, screens, identifiable bystanders or reflective faces.
props: Exact Amber and Charme bottles, red pouch, burgundy strap, orange notebook and yellow bench. Do not use flags, London landmarks or manufacturing badges as substitutes for the brand story.
lighting: Warm sunlight and gentle fill. Retain Amber's pale-peach liquid, Charme's orange-amber liquid and the difference between white and black labels.
camera: Overhead master framed on hands and bench, with one close-up per product. Avoid any angle that looks upward at either performer.
performance: Each person holds their own line's bottle and adjusts one personal item. The gestures can interact through timing but bottles stay with the correct talent.
sound: Licensed optimistic instrumental with light bag and notebook sounds. One warm narrator, conversational pace, without a dramatic travel-story delivery.
shots: Open on both bottles held above the yellow bench, separated and label-forward.

title: Find what feels like you
objective: Make fragrance discovery feel personal using the existing wearer-personality descriptions, while inviting exploration of all six priority scents.
casting: One adult Filipino woman's hand beside white-label Mojito; one adult Filipino man's hand beside black-label Oud. No faces, heads or partial faces.
description: Mojito Metallique: friendly, easygoing, lighthearted. Oud Mirage: independent, reflective, self-assured. These are brand personality interpretations, not measurable effects of wearing a fragrance.
scene: Two personal-style arrangements share a burnt-orange tabletop. Left: Mojito, yellow ribbing, red pouch and cream headphones. Right: Oud, burgundy journal, cobalt strap and cream tray. The side-by-side styling gives a visual choice without labeling one personality better.
styling: Her coral nails and warm yellow accents; his natural nails and burgundy/cream accents. Warm orange dominates the frame; blue is limited to Oud and the bag strap.
props: Exact Mojito and Oud bottles, two small personal-style sets, cream tray. The notebook stays closed; no quizzes or fictional personality-test results appear on screens.
lighting: Sunlit editorial light with fill across both labels so one side is not visually privileged. Keep both bottles equally sharp and similarly sized.
camera: Three-quarter overhead view, locked two-product master with separate product inserts. Keep both hand positions low enough to preserve the labels.
performance: Let the woman's fingertips rest near Mojito's base and the man's hand settle on the tray beside Oud. Small gestures establish ownership; avoid presenting a forced choice or a claim about the viewer.
sound: Licensed light groove; use a headphone tap for the left vignette and a soft journal set-down for the right, balanced in level.
